help: stage a manifest and its payload: the manifest copied from where the download left it, each file fetched from its one-use export_url into the data-* directory sharing the manifest's star (manifest-<X>.json beside data-<X>/) - refused if that directory is staged or held

args.name: --manifest
args.help: the manifest, wherever the download left it - required: each export_url is one-use, so no default picks one

args.name: --to
args.help: stage under a directory instead of the stage (test escape hatch - a directory, never a machine name)

https://claude.ai/export/... (urllib): WRITES nothing outward, but each export_url is one-use: the fetch consumes it (refused loudly under YOGA_NO_SEND)
